Title: Agree on shared access contracts
Requirement: Define brand, actor, action, version and request identity in shared fixtures. Provide success, empty and denied examples for both teams.
Acceptance test: The same fixture queried by a Brand A and a Brand B user returns the Brand A result and a denial respectively. Both clients handle an empty result.
Résultat et écart: Contrats de marque, session et permissions avec lectures autorisées, vides et refusées.

Title: Enforce grants and record staff actions
Requirement: Implement named invites, brand-scoped roles, explicit publish and suspension rights, revocation, and a searchable audit log with before/after changes.
Acceptance test: Revoke an editor and retry the next publish. The live revision stays unchanged. An authorized publish and its duplicate produce one audit entry naming the original editor.
Résultat et écart: Révocation, publication avec identifiant de requête et acteur nommé vérifiées.

Title: Provision partner defaults and workspace
Requirement: Offer demo or company onboarding and configurable partner type. Store default and supported languages/currencies and a reporting time zone. Scope search, recent items and alerts to the selected partner.
Acceptance test: Create a white-label partner with English and Spanish and a test currency. Switch to a second partner and verify the first partner’s recent records and notifications disappear.
Résultat et écart: Marques et domaines existent. Le parcours d’accueil en espagnol, les valeurs par partenaire et les alertes récentes restent à livrer.

Title: Register, recover and restore a session
Requirement: Provide configurable brand registration fields, email verification, login, one-use recovery and account screens. Return non-revealing recovery acknowledgments.
Acceptance test: A verified player signs in on a second device. A consumed recovery link cannot reset the account a second time. An unverified account follows the verification path.
Résultat et écart: Inscription, vérification, récupération et deux sessions indépendantes exercées.

Title: Find a player and restrict activity
Requirement: Search by ID or email, show location/status and dated activity, and allow a permitted supervisor to suspend or restore with a reason. Link future balance and identity summaries by permission.
Acceptance test: Suspend a player with a signed-in session. The next restricted action is denied, the reason appears in staff history, and a support user from another brand cannot open that record.
Source reference IDs: SL-10, SL-11, EM-01, EM-N03, NX-F07, NX-F08, NX-F46, NX-M02, NX-N01
Résultat et écart: Suspension, invalidation de session et consultation par marque et rôle exercées.

Title: Work a player support case
Requirement: Assign, comment, attach a permitted reference and move a case from open to resolved. Preserve chronology and show reopened cases in the queue.
Acceptance test: Reopen a resolved case. The assignee sees it once, the original resolution remains visible, and an account-facing view omits staff-only notes.
Résultat et écart: Dossiers, réouverture, attribution, notes privées et réponses existent. Le critère complet de réouverture avec l’ancienne résolution et l’assignation unique reste à rejouer tel quel.

Title: Browse products by availability
Requirement: Represent the 13 product cards and their observed availability in a reference fixture. Expose category, update date, setup schema and release notes. Store activation independently.
Acceptance test: Sportsbook and Live Casino expose setup. A Coming Soon card cannot request activation. Filtering by gaming products does not change saved entitlements.
Résultat et écart: 13 fiches de référence, catégorie et notes datées. Deux configurations fictives disponibles. Les activations sont propres à la marque.

Title: Activate a product and a supplier
Requirement: Version setup, run a connector check and persist the effective state per brand, product, provider and environment. Record failed checks and support retry.
Acceptance test: Enable Live Casino with two provider fixtures and activate only A. A becomes launch-eligible after its check. B stays disabled. Retrying the same activation creates one binding.
Résultat et écart: Le simulateur valide séparément le produit et deux fournisseurs, versionne le résultat et rejoue le reçu d’activation.

Title: Suspend and recover a binding
Requirement: Expose pending, active, suspended and failed states. Provide an operator reason, configuration history and links to unresolved integration issues.
Acceptance test: A failing health check leaves a new binding pending or failed. After credentials are corrected, retry activates the same record. Suspending it removes it from new launch decisions.
Résultat et écart: Panne, motif, nouvelle tentative, historique et suspension exercés. La vérification locale est synchrone. La file des vérifications en attente et les incidents d’un fournisseur externe restent ouverts.

Title: Create the shared test environment
Requirement: Provide a seeded test brand, a second isolated brand and staff/player fixtures. Version shared response examples and restore data to a disposable instance.
Acceptance test: Both teams can sign in with the documented test roles, retrieve a draft and published fixture as permitted and reset the fixtures to their original state.
Résultat et écart: Environnement isolé, jeux d’essai et rôles disponibles. Le parcours exact de remise à zéro partagé entre les deux équipes reste à valider.

Title: Restore a published catalogue and audit history
Requirement: Back up published site revisions, assets, titles, player saves and audit records. Give operations a repeatable restore and a data integrity check.
Acceptance test: A restore to an isolated instance yields the expected live revision, media, sample player save and named publish audit. Its environment settings cannot contact live processors.
Résultat et écart: La restauration démarre un second service, retrouve publication, favoris, historique et reçus, puis vérifie SQLite.

Title: Launch a partner site from a template
Requirement: Implement domain reservation, template preview/selection, launch progress and My sites. Keep the selected theme version on the site record.
Acceptance test: Two partners request the same hostname. One reservation succeeds. An interrupted launch resumes once, producing one site card with its verified hostname.
Résultat et écart: Réservation et vérification DNS existent. Aucun assistant de modèle avec reprise d’un lancement interrompu n’a été trouvé.

Title: Draft, preview and publish core content
Requirement: Manage banners, help pages, menu destinations, localized copy, artwork and alt text. Show a preview and require a publication grant.
Acceptance test: Change a banner on the draft. The public page keeps the old one until publish. A fresh visit then shows the new banner and the audit points to its revision.
Résultat et écart: Brouillon et publication de bannière, historique et rendu public couverts.

Title: Localize pages and control search metadata
Requirement: Store locale-specific slugs or stable aliases, titles, descriptions and indexing settings. Resolve blank translations per field from the configured default.
Acceptance test: Leave Spanish help copy blank and publish a translated title. The Spanish page shows its title and the default body. A previously advertised stable URL still reaches the page.
Résultat et écart: Pages, URL stables, métadonnées et traductions FR/EN couverts. Le scénario éditorial espagnol complet reste ouvert.

Title: Compose pages from blocks and themes
Requirement: Provide layout, text, image, video, button, slider and spacing blocks. Preview theme/typography at four widths. Expose the ten vendor page roles as templates tied to enabled features.
Acceptance test: Insert a section below a carousel, switch theme and preview on phone and desktop. Publish then revert. Both views restore the previous block order and theme.
Résultat et écart: L’éditeur couvre des types de contenu fixes. Composition libre de blocs, carrousel, thème et restauration de disposition restent à développer.

Title: Create a canonical preview card
Requirement: Store title, studio, art/alt text, categories, supported locales, market, visibility and Featured order. Validate required fields before publication.
Acceptance test: Two games with the same display name keep distinct IDs. An incomplete draft stays editable and cannot appear in a public catalogue response.
Résultat et écart: Identité de fiche et séparation brouillon/publication présentes. Le cas de deux titres homonymes et d’un brouillon incomplet reste à qualifier.

Title: Publish, archive and retain history
Requirement: Make a revision visible atomically in search, lobby and preview. Invalidate public caches on archive and preserve prior staff and player activity.
Acceptance test: Publish Neon Orchard as the sixth eligible card. Archive it and refresh. The public count returns to five and its staff publish record remains queryable.
Résultat et écart: Neon Orchard apparaît comme sixième fiche, puis l’archive ramène le total à cinq. Le journal garde l’auteur.

Title: Import a normalized multi-studio feed
Requirement: Map supplier/sub-vendor, native ID, type, tags, devices, artwork and demo/bonus-buy attributes. Report unknown types, duplicate keys, adds and withdrawals.
Acceptance test: Import the same 10-row feed twice. Ten canonical records result. An unknown type is staged for review. The second import preserves an editorial art override.
Source reference IDs: SB-22, EM-02, EM-06, EM-N07, EM-N09, NX-F02, NX-F05, NX-F61, NX-M01, NX-M13, NX-N05
Résultat et écart: Import canonique réexécutable, suivi des différences et visibilité éditoriale disponibles. Les types inconnus sont rejetés. File de revue, sous-studios et remplacement d’illustration restent ouverts.

Title: Filter availability and show product indicators
Requirement: Apply supplier enablement, jurisdiction, device and format gates. Support mechanic, volatility and jackpot tags. Treat a missing capability flag as unknown.
Acceptance test: Disable a studio for one market. Its titles disappear there, including direct discovery links. A title with unknown bonus-buy support displays no positive indicator.
Résultat et écart: Une fiche masquée sort du hall et des démos de catalogue. Les droits de distribution par studio/marché et indicateurs métier du fournisseur restent à intégrer.

Title: Publish an ordered Featured shelf
Requirement: Provide explicit sort, add/remove, hide and a live preview of the eligible result. Keep Featured independent of the randomly sampled Discover shelf.
Acceptance test: Move game C ahead of A in Featured. A fresh public view reflects the order. Archiving C removes it, and staff can still inspect the previous revision.
Résultat et écart: Rangs vedettes existants et nouvelle sélection ordonnée avec aperçu, masquage et historique en base. La comparaison de deux anciennes révisions dans l’éditeur reste ouverte.

Title: Rank, cap and pin a dynamic category
Requirement: Support Normal, New, Popular and Jackpot types, the 15 demo type filters, category art and editable rules. Offer rounds-in-lookback as a ranking input with rule preview.
Acceptance test: With a frozen metric fixture, cap a Popular shelf at three, pin game B to slot 2 and hide the top-ranked title. The three eligible results are stable after refresh and contain no duplicates.
Résultat et écart: Rang fixe, exclusions, plafond et remplissage stable par titre ou nouveauté. Les scores de popularité sur fenêtre, jackpots, 15 types et illustrations restent ouverts.

Title: Schedule and target a lobby revision
Requirement: Save local start/end, selected time zone, channel, market and audience. Reject ambiguous overlaps of equal priority and show exact preview times and localized art.
Acceptance test: A seasonal shelf appears at start and disappears at its exclusive end. A blank Spanish label falls back to default. A recently disabled title stays hidden in every variant.
Résultat et écart: Marché, appareil, priorités, fuseau, chevauchements, fin exclusive et repli espagnol exercés. Segments nommés et illustrations localisées restent ouverts.

Title: Deliver stable discovery and saves
Requirement: Sample up to six unique eligible cards with equal probability, stable during a visit until 30 minutes of inactivity. Keep a player’s saved shelf ordered by saved time across devices.
Acceptance test: From eight eligible cards show six unique IDs. Refresh the visit and keep their order. Save on phone then laptop and record one save. With zero eligible cards show the project empty state.
Résultat et écart: Découverte stable par visite, états vides et favori unique entre deux appareils exercés.

Title: Search and browse collections
Requirement: Add game-name search and filters for category, studio and device, count eligible results, and preserve the saved state while browsing.
Acceptance test: A market with three matching searchable games returns three. Archiving one reduces both shelf and search to two on refresh. A saved archived title remains in staff history.
Résultat et écart: Recherche bilingue, collections et retrait des titres archivés avec conservation de l’historique.

Title: Serve channel variants and recommendations
Requirement: Allow approved rule-based suggestions, collection rows and a random eligible title. Use a published default shelf for a guest or empty audience. Record variant and slot.
Acceptance test: A guest receives the default order. A VIP fixture receives its assigned shelf on mobile. A withdrawn or restricted title is excluded from both suggestions and random selection.
Résultat et écart: Ordre par défaut et variantes par marché/appareil dans les deux interfaces. Personnalisation VIP et suggestions par profil restent à construire.

Title: Share an invited collection
Requirement: Support invitations, membership, suggestions, moderation and one current vote per member. Keep private saves scoped to their owner.
Acceptance test: Revoke one invitation before acceptance. That visitor cannot read the list, the accepted member can suggest a game, and neither can open the owner’s private saved shelf.
Résultat et écart: Collections privées sur invitation, révocation, suggestions et modération couvertes.

Title: Store preferences and deliver inbox messages
Requirement: Capture channel, purpose, source, time and terms version. Allow opt-out and a player inbox. Record a reason when promotional delivery is suppressed.
Acceptance test: Queue a promotion, then start a timed break before dispatch. The job records a suppression and sends no promotion. An applicable account-service message remains available.
Résultat et écart: Préférences par canal, messagerie de service et suppression promotionnelle au départ en pause vérifiées.

Title: Run scheduled campaigns by segment
Requirement: Build versioned market/activity segments, preview counts, link a stable creative destination, schedule in the brand time zone and export outcomes.
Acceptance test: A three-player fixture contains one eligible, one opted out and one on a break. Dispatch creates one delivery and two distinct suppression outcomes. A retry preserves all counts.
Résultat et écart: Consentement et pause revérifiés au départ des envois, avec résultat et historique par destinataire.

Title: Sync permitted segments to an external CRM
Requirement: Map approved fields and purposes, recheck suppression on export, and version the connector mapping. Limit access to sensitive financial or case attributes.
Acceptance test: An opt-out after audience snapshot removes that account from the outgoing promotional list. A delayed sync resumes from its checkpoint and does not duplicate the remaining contact.
Résultat et écart: Les campagnes locales utilisent les consentements. La synchronisation CRM sortante avec point de reprise reste à fournir.

Title: Attribute and qualify a referral once
Requirement: Track links and signup codes, apply the project priority rule, hold self/duplicate referrals for review, and qualify after verification and a first eligible save.
Acceptance test: Register from link A using valid code B. Verify and save twice. B receives one qualification, A receives none, and a repeated event leaves both totals unchanged.
Résultat et écart: Priorité du code sur le lien, qualification à la première sauvegarde et déduplication contrôlées.

Title: Expose scoped partner reports
Requirement: Show clicks, attributed signups, qualifications and review adjustments by brand, affiliate, campaign and period. Provide a scoped export.
Acceptance test: For one fixture cohort, the partner portal and operator export show the same qualified count. Affiliate A cannot open affiliate B’s statement by changing the selected ID.
Résultat et écart: Portail cloisonné par partenaire, totaux et export à date fixe exercés.

Title: Settle an approved affiliate offer
Requirement: Version commission terms and affiliate-issued promotion authority. Define trigger, reversal rules and approval rights before enabling payments or sub-affiliate accounting.
Acceptance test: A qualifying event is reversed after the statement closes. Post one adjustment referencing the original statement and rule. A partner without the bonus grant cannot issue a no-deposit offer.
Résultat et écart: Attribution et revue disponibles. Commissions, relevés financiers fermés et corrections des commissions restent à livrer.

Title: Issue a cosmetic offer with a receipt
Requirement: Show eligibility, opening/expiry, per-account limit and stock. Grant one entitlement per successful claim and allow the player to revisit the receipt.
Acceptance test: Two eligible accounts claim the last badge concurrently. One receives it. The other sees exhausted stock. A retry by the winner returns the same receipt.
Résultat et écart: Réclamation cosmétique, dernière unité concurrente et reçu rejouable exercés.

Title: Implement funded bonus terms
Requirement: Version registration/deposit triggers, qualifying period and amount, eligible games, wager contribution, funding priority, winnings destination, expiry and claim caps.
Acceptance test: A sandbox offer grants 10 bonus units at 2× wagering. Two eligible settled 10-unit stakes complete 20 units of progress. An excluded game adds zero and a reversed stake removes its contribution.
Source reference IDs: SL-09, SL-12, SB-22, EM-N06, NX-F19, NX-F20, NX-F23, NX-F24, NX-M04
Résultat et écart: La récompense actuelle est cosmétique. Fonds bonus, contribution des mises et annulation de contribution restent ouverts.

Title: Issue cashback and provider free spins
Requirement: Support capped positive net-loss cashback for a specified window, and free spins on contracted games. Handle provider grant references, expiry and retries.
Acceptance test: For 100 in qualifying stakes and 30 in winnings over seven days at 10%, post 7.00 before any cap. A negative net loss yields zero. A repeated spin-grant acknowledgment leaves one grant.
Résultat et écart: Aucun calcul de remise financière ni accusé d’octroi de tours fournisseur implémenté.

Title: Complete the Lobby Curator quest
Requirement: Offer opt-in, rule version and progress UI. Count three distinct eligible saves toward a cosmetic award. Ignore repeated saves and actions during an account break.
Acceptance test: Save A, A, B and C while enrolled. Progress reads 3/3 and emits one completion. Replaying the event stream yields the same progress and award eligibility.
Résultat et écart: Les sauvegardes distinctes font avancer la quête une seule fois et le résultat est retrouvé sur un second appareil.

Title: Show cosmetic inventory on the profile
Requirement: List owned badges/themes, let the account select an owned item and show claim origin, date and current availability.
Acceptance test: Claim one badge, equip it on a phone and reopen the profile on a laptop. The badge is equipped, one receipt exists and another account cannot equip it.
Résultat et écart: Badge équipé, reçu, autre session et contrôle de propriété vérifiés.

Title: Maintain points and VIP tiers
Requirement: Version earning events, referral qualification, tier thresholds, expiry, demotion and benefits. Post one reward per qualifying event and report tier changes, redemptions and costs.
Acceptance test: At a 100-point threshold, moving from 99 to 100 upgrades the player once. Reversing the event follows the configured demotion rule and leaves a visible journal entry.
Source reference IDs: SL-12, EM-16, NX-F26, NX-F27, NX-F33, NX-F34, NX-M05
Résultat et écart: Points, passage de palier et politique de rétrogradation après annulation restent ouverts.

Title: Run contests and publish winner views
Requirement: Configure tournament/PvP entry, score sources, tie-breaks and closure. A prize wheel needs an approved inventory, frequency and draw policy. Publish Recent/Top Winners with privacy controls.
Acceptance test: Tie two players on score. The configured tie-break is deterministic. After close, retry awarding the winner and issue one prize. A player outside the eligible cohort cannot enter.
Résultat et écart: Sondages et progression existent. Classement de concours, départage et attribution unique du prix restent ouverts.

Title: Fulfill reward shop orders
Requirement: Reserve inventory and debit points in one redemption workflow. Support order status, cancellation policy, controlled address access and compensating credits.
Acceptance test: Two eligible players redeem the last unit. Exactly one order reserves it and spends points. Cancel it before fulfillment and restore stock and points exactly once.
Résultat et écart: Stock et réclamations cosmétiques atomiques présents. Panier en points, réservation puis remboursement sur annulation restent ouverts.

Title: Deliver the first operational dashboard
Requirement: Define verified signups, active accounts, first saves and current eligible cards. Show report zone, as-of time and scoped drilldowns.
Acceptance test: Publish the sixth card, save it twice with the same account, then archive it. Card count moves 5–6–5 and the first-save total increases by one.
Résultat et écart: Publications et premières sauvegardes se rapprochent des enregistrements détaillés.

Title: Deliver campaign reporting and exports
Requirement: Support daily or requested reporting by affiliate, campaign and observation window. Preserve query inputs and export permissions in CSV or structured JSON.
Acceptance test: Rerun a fixed campaign cohort at the same watermark. The dashboard, CSV and JSON show equal qualification counts, and the other brand’s rows are absent.
Source reference IDs: SL-08, SB-19, EM-21, EM-N17, NX-F12, NX-F13, NX-F25
Résultat et écart: Les rapports d’acquisition, la cohorte figée et les exports opérateur/partenaire se rapprochent au même instant.

Title: Compare financial and lobby performance
Requirement: Add settled stakes, wins, GGR, deposits/withdrawals and placement metrics. Compare game by slot and slot by game using eligible impressions, unique launches and sample size.
Acceptance test: One placement receives 100 counted impressions and five qualifying launches. It shows 5%. Zero impressions shows unavailable. Drilldown ties GGR to the corrected round totals by currency.
Source reference IDs: SL-03, SL-08, SL-11, EM-21, EM-N01, NX-F11, NX-F25, NX-F34, NX-F62, NX-N04
Résultat et écart: Montants, GGR et écritures fictives traçables. Le taux lancement/impression par emplacement et le GGR corrigé multi-devises restent ouverts.

Title: Run controlled placement or campaign experiments
Requirement: Use stable assignments, a holdout, a defined observation window and an eligibility snapshot. Store the experiment alongside reporting dimensions.
Acceptance test: Revisit the same account and preserve its assignment. Recompute one completed window at the same watermark and reproduce both cohort denominators and results.
Résultat et écart: Affectations stables et résultats du groupe témoin reproductibles au même instant.

Title: Configure identity evidence and intake
Requirement: Version required document types, age decision parameters, market and protected actions. Provide a resumable flow and show pending, more-information and completed outcomes.
Acceptance test: Two configured markets request different document sets. A missing required item keeps the case pending and a support-only user sees its status without document contents.
Résultat et écart: La vérification de courriel couvre l’accès au compte. Les politiques de pièces par marché et le dépôt confidentiel restent à développer.

Title: Process checks and manual review
Requirement: Normalize document/age checks, facial match and liveness where selected. Deduplicate provider updates and record a reviewer reason and immutable decision history.
Acceptance test: Replay a pending then review-required callback twice. One open task remains. Approval records one decision and the player timeline receives only the permitted summary.
Source reference IDs: SL-14, NX-F07, NX-F41, NX-F42, NX-F45, NX-M07, NX-N03
Résultat et écart: Aucune file de vérification d’identité avec décision manuelle et rappels fournisseur dédupliqués identifiée.

Title: Re-evaluate protected actions on expiry
Requirement: Resolve a versioned verification policy on launch or payout as configured. Preserve older evidence and link superseding decisions.
Acceptance test: Expire a verified case before a sandbox payout. Its next authorization returns review-required. After approved re-verification it proceeds under the new decision reference.
Résultat et écart: Aucune autorisation de retrait liée à une décision d’identité expirante identifiée.

Title: Triage duplicate or suspicious activity
Requirement: Route configured duplicate-account, bonus-abuse and payment anomalies to analyst review. Link evidence references, assign ownership and retain a disposition.
Acceptance test: Two copies of one fixture signal create one case. Two distinct accounts with a shared attribute remain separate records and can be cleared independently after review.
Résultat et écart: Le contrôle des doublons de parrainage existe. Les signaux de risque multi-comptes et les dossiers indépendants restent ouverts.

Title: Track screening and list updates
Requirement: Store the screening provider, list version, match reason, reviewer and rescreen result. Support cleared matches and cases requiring information.
Acceptance test: A new list version changes one candidate. Create a linked review task once, preserve the earlier cleared decision, and record the reason for the new outcome.
Résultat et écart: Versions des listes de contrôle, rapprochements et réexamen des décisions restent ouverts.

Title: Apply and release governed restrictions
Requirement: Apply a policy-selected hold to a named action. Require a reason and any configured second approval. Propagate the active decision to cashier and launch checks.
Acceptance test: A withdrawal hold blocks a new payout but allows the assigned reviewer to investigate. Releasing it once restores eligibility if every other gate passes and leaves the earlier hold visible.
Résultat et écart: Restrictions de compte existantes. Le blocage ciblé d’un retrait, sa libération contrôlée et son motif restent ouverts.

Title: Implement an account break
Requirement: Persist effective start and end, expose the countdown and eligibility result, and suppress new quest actions, claims and promotional dispatch during the break.
Acceptance test: Start a break with one promotion queued. A new qualifying save cannot advance the quest, a claim is denied, and the public catalogue preview remains accessible.
Résultat et écart: Pause, blocage de la progression et suppression des promotions sont testés sur plusieurs sessions.

Title: Enforce cross-vendor limits
Requirement: Check shared time and wagering budgets across vendors, reserve eligible units atomically and release unused reservations. Record policy version and effective time.
Acceptance test: With 10 units remaining, two vendors each request 8 simultaneously. At most one succeeds. A late settlement of an already accepted bet resolves once during a break.
Résultat et écart: V06 envoie deux requêtes de fournisseurs concurrents, applique une limite partagée, puis autorise le règlement tardif unique pendant la pause. Périmètre fictif TST.

Title: Deliver six game-window notices
Requirement: Handle mandatory break, time limit, money limit, suspension, maintenance and closure. Define blocking behavior, acknowledgment, reconnect and contact/support actions.
Acceptance test: Reconnect after a mandatory break begins. The current blocking notice appears before any new wager can be sent. Acknowledgment alone does not restore eligibility.
Résultat et écart: Les pauses et avis de session existent. Le contrat des six avis dans la fenêtre fournisseur reste ouvert.

Title: Build auditable sandbox wallet journals
Requirement: Create per-brand, per-asset accounts with available/held balances, fund source and balanced immutable journal entries. Add journal lookup and reconstruction.
Acceptance test: Post a 100.00 test-fixture deposit from a clearing account. Player balance is 100.00, journal sums to zero in that currency, and rebuilding from journal lines returns the same result.
Résultat et écart: Les dépôts fictifs créent deux lignes par écriture. Le solde est recalculé depuis les lignes et chaque écriture est équilibrée en TST.

Title: Reserve, capture, release and reverse
Requirement: Serialize competing debits against available funds. Link partial/full captures, unused releases and compensating reversals to original postings; reject mismatched duplicate payloads.
Acceptance test: With 10.00 available, two 8.00 holds compete. One succeeds. Capture 5.00, release 3.00 and reverse the capture once. Available ends at 10.00 with no open hold.
Résultat et écart: Réservation et capture d’un retrait présentes. Capture partielle, libération partielle et contrepassation plafonnée restent à qualifier ensemble.

Title: Quote cross-currency play
Requirement: Let players choose an eligible balance, store both currency amounts, quote ID, rate, expiry and rounding rule. Use the original booked amounts for a reversal.
Acceptance test: At a fixture quote of 2.00 account units per game unit, a 3.00 game debit books 6.00 account units. A later rate change leaves the reversal at 6.00. An expired new quote is rejected.
Résultat et écart: Le registre fictif utilise une seule unité TST. Cotation change, expiration et contrepassation au taux initial restent ouvertes.

Title: Configure payment routes in sandbox
Requirement: Store processor, deposit/withdrawal capabilities, enabled markets/currencies, limits, priority and connection status. Display only eligible methods.
Acceptance test: Configure a combined card route and a separate wallet route for one market. Unsupported currency, disabled route and an amount above the limit each yield an explanatory result.
Résultat et écart: Le simulateur confirme des mouvements. Une configuration de routes par moyen, devise, marché et montant reste à développer.

Title: Credit a confirmed deposit exactly once
Requirement: Track initiated, pending, confirmed, failed and reversed outcomes. Verify provider events and match brand, amount and currency before posting. Link chargebacks to original movements.
Acceptance test: A return page arrives before the provider event. Balance stays unchanged. Deliver the verified 50.00 confirmation twice; one 50.00 credit and one receipt appear.
Résultat et écart: Une confirmation fictive répétée produit un seul dépôt. Le retour navigateur indépendant et la confirmation authentifiée d’un processeur restent ouverts.

Title: Reserve and resolve a withdrawal
Requirement: Check eligibility, hold available funds, capture approval when required, submit once and store processor state. Publish status, reason and last update to support.
Acceptance test: Send a 20.00 payout and simulate a timeout. Its hold stays in place through retry/status lookup. Definitive success captures it once; a separate definitively declined fixture releases its hold.
Résultat et écart: V07 couvre le montant réservé, le délai dépassé et une seule capture sur succès. Un deuxième cas de refus définitif libérant les fonds reste à exercer.

Title: Launch a sandbox game session
Requirement: Route one supported title to the correct sandbox provider. Support demo mode, capability indicators, currency checks and an actionable unavailable response.
Acceptance test: Launch an enabled demo title and follow its session ID to the provider fixture. Disable the provider and a new launch fails cleanly. Demo play produces no monetary journal entry.
Résultat et écart: Nouvelle session soumise à la disponibilité du produit, du fournisseur fictif et de la fiche importée. Le solde joueur reste intact.

Title: Process a wager, win and rollback once
Requirement: Recheck restrictions on new bets, record round IDs, post wallet entries once, and permit valid late settlement of a previously accepted round. Quarantine unknown references.
Acceptance test: From 100.00, debit 10.00 and credit 6.00. Replaying both callbacks leaves 96.00. Roll back only the debit once and reach 106.00. A duplicate key with a changed amount posts nothing.
Résultat et écart: Mise, gain et répétitions validés en TST. Contrepassation du débit et traitement opérationnel d’un conflit de montant restent à compléter.

Title: Expose controlled real-play and window actions
Requirement: Route real or demo mode explicitly. Surface protection notices, balance refresh and supported toolbar transfers through authoritative services. Hide an unavailable action.
Acceptance test: A newly suspended game blocks a direct real-play launch despite a cached tile. An already accepted round can settle, and a supported transfer returns a journal receipt.
Résultat et écart: Une nouvelle démo est refusée après suspension, la manche ouverte se termine. Les actions de fenêtre et l’autorité pour le jeu en argent réel restent ouvertes.

Title: Inspect sessions and supported replays
Requirement: Link provider and operator round IDs, accepted events, status and replay references. Provide a clear unavailable state for suppliers without replay support.
Acceptance test: For one sandbox round, the session timeline links to its replay and IDs. A second provider with no replay capability shows its available round details and no playable control.
Source reference IDs: EM-17, EM-18, EM-N11, EM-N15, NX-F08, NX-F60
Résultat et écart: Chronologie de session et relecture textuelle pour Atlas. Cedar conserve le détail sans proposer de relecture.

Title: Recover an open round and notify players
Requirement: Flag a round past the configured age, assign an investigator, retrieve supplier status and finalize or escalate. Route maintenance/closure to the game-window notice service.
Acceptance test: A delayed win arrives during investigation. The round settles once and leaves the open queue. Staff can see the original alert, late event and linked wallet receipt.
Résultat et écart: Une manche ouverte reçoit le règlement tardif une fois et sort des manches ouvertes. File d’enquête et avis joueur restent à livrer.

Title: Add RTP and jackpot monitoring
Requirement: Define observed RTP as settled wins divided by eligible settled stakes for a disclosed scope; store supplier jackpot feed balances separately. Discover unspecified vendor monitoring fields before release.
Acceptance test: Wins of 90 on stakes of 100 show 90% for the chosen sample. Zero stake is unavailable. A stale jackpot feed retains its last value with its timestamp and a stale indicator.
Résultat et écart: Mises et gains fictifs observables. Surveillance des jackpots horodatés, périmètre d’échantillon et fraîcheur du flux restent ouverts.

Title: Match rounds, journals and settlements
Requirement: Import signed/verified statement artifacts or authorized fixture files with date, currency and provider metadata. Join to round, wallet and processor IDs; retain unmatched lines.
Acceptance test: With internal stakes 100 and winnings 90, internal GGR is 10. A provider reports 12. The 2-unit difference opens an exception with traceable source rows. Reimport creates none extra.
Résultat et écart: Rapprochement et déduplication par ligne externe dans V05. Le cas d’écart GGR fournisseur de 2 unités et son traitement restent ouverts.

Title: Resolve exceptions and corrections
Requirement: Classify timing, missing transaction, fee, reversal and duplicate. Require evidence and an authorized adjustment. Track owner, aging and unresolved amounts.
Acceptance test: Match a late 20.00 settlement to its existing payout. Clear the timing exception without creating another payout. An amount mismatch remains open until resolved or accepted by policy.
Résultat et écart: Un relevé tardif résout l’écart de date sans second retrait. La décision opérateur sur écart de montant reste ouverte.

Title: Close a period and reproduce it
Requirement: Capture currency, provider, time zone, cutoff, watermark, unmatched totals, reviewer and statement versions. Route late changes to a later adjustment or formally reopened close.
Acceptance test: Rerun a closed snapshot and get identical totals. A late refund appears as a linked adjustment. Reopening records a reason and a second close version while retaining the first.
Résultat et écart: Deux clôtures conservées après relevé tardif. Réouverture motivée, remboursement tardif et contrôles de période restent ouverts.

Title: Search a service catalogue
Requirement: Seed the 14 reference service types; allow search and the five service groups plus All. Store description, pricing model, FAQ and contact for eligible services.
Acceptance test: Searching translation returns Translation and Localisation. Selecting IT filters the fixture catalogue. An unavailable service shows its availability without allowing order creation.
Résultat et écart: 14 services filtrables, recherche bilingue, disponibilité et commande de traduction exercées.

Title: Order a website translation and follow it
Requirement: Accept title, source/target language, brief and optional file. Record dates, Ordered state, owner, comments and attachment visibility. Track handoffs through delivery.
Acceptance test: Request English-to-Spanish website translation without a file. My Orders shows one Ordered request. A comment becomes visible to its partner and assigned agent only.
Résultat et écart: Commande anglais–espagnol, pièce texte facultative, commentaires des participants, changement d’agent et suivi jusqu’à la livraison.

Title: Handle quotes, estimates and invoices
Requirement: After commercial terms are defined, record a versioned offer, acceptance, approved price and invoice reference. Keep estimated and invoiced amounts separate.
Acceptance test: Accept quote version 2 and issue one invoice reference. A resend returns that reference. Version 1 remains visible in history and an unaccepted order has no billed amount.
Résultat et écart: Devis 1 et 2 conservés, acceptation du dernier, une seule référence de facture fictive. Unité TST.

Title: Configure trading limits by product
Requirement: Expose Max Payout, Max Odd and Selection Liability with units and version history. The values 5,000 / 1,000 / 10,000 are demo fixtures only.
Acceptance test: At configured limits, an in-range fixture is eligible and a selection exceeding liability is rejected. Two concurrent requests cannot reserve more than the remaining liability.
Résultat et écart: Le répertoire expose le paramétrage de démonstration du produit. Moteur de risque et plafond de responsabilité sportsbook à sélectionner et développer.

Title: Accept and settle a fixed-price bet
Requirement: Obtain pre-match/live availability, retain offered vs accepted odds, surface suspension, and record result/void corrections through wallet postings.
Acceptance test: Move decimal odds from 2.00 to 1.80 before acceptance. Under explicit reconfirmation, no debit occurs until confirmed. A duplicate settlement returns the same receipt.
Résultat et écart: Sélection de la verticale, politique de changement de cote et adaptateur de règlement attendus.

Title: Implement supported cash-out variants
Requirement: Support full, partial or automatic cash-out only for agreed provider capabilities. Store quote, residual exposure, expiry, acceptance and final state.
Acceptance test: Accept a partial quote within its lifetime. Exactly one payout is posted and remaining exposure is updated. Retry an expired quote and receive an expired result with no debit or credit.
Résultat et écart: Cash-out total et partiel, durée de cotation et exposition dépendent du produit retenu.

Title: Link an external wallet on a supported network
Requirement: Configure an asset/network allowlist, custody model and address ownership proof. Display asset name, network, precision and connection status.
Acceptance test: A supported test address links once to the authorized account after a one-use challenge. An unsupported network cannot generate a funding instruction.
Résultat et écart: Réseau, actif, garde et fournisseur à choisir avant la liaison des adresses.

Title: Confirm and reconcile asset deposits
Requirement: Track observed, confirming, confirmed and exception states. Honor network-specific finality and asset precision for supported stablecoins or other approved assets.
Acceptance test: Deliver two indexed transfers within one fixture transaction and duplicate one notification. Credit each distinct transfer once after its confirmation threshold, with both source IDs visible.
Résultat et écart: Indexation et seuil de confirmation dépendent du réseau et du fournisseur sélectionnés.

Title: Resolve payouts and chain corrections
Requirement: Use the existing payout hold and review model with network fee, destination and custody references. Route reversals or reorganizations to a reasoned correction workflow.
Acceptance test: A provider timeout leaves one open payout. A later confirmation completes it once. A simulated reorganization of a credited deposit opens a linked exception and preserves the original journal.
Résultat et écart: Le traitement des réorganisations et des paiements crypto dépend du modèle de garde retenu.

Title: Link or revoke a chat identity
Requirement: Provide one-use linking and explicit account confirmation, a current link list, revocation and expiry. Reuse existing accounts.
Acceptance test: A challenge used by the correct chat creates one link. Reusing it in a second chat fails. Unlinking invalidates the first chat’s next protected action.
Résultat et écart: Canal Telegram à sélectionner. Aucune association d’identité de messagerie livrée.

Title: Route chat actions to the shared platform
Requirement: Expose games, account, cashier, rewards and support. Reopen current account state on the authenticated surface and keep transaction IDs shared with the web console.
Acceptance test: Start a payout in Telegram, complete it in the authenticated cashier and find the same payment ID in staff history. A player under a payout hold sees the same restriction through both channels.
Résultat et écart: Le passage d’une conversation à la caisse doit partager l’identité et les contrôles de retrait.

Title: Deduplicate updates and respect messaging preferences
Requirement: Record bot update receipts, localize responses and send promotions only when current channel consent and account restrictions allow.
Acceptance test: Replay a bot action twice and return one result. Opt out before a scheduled promotion and record one suppression. An expired link sends the account through relinking.
Résultat et écart: Consentements web présents. Réception dédupliquée et retrait d’accès du bot restent ouverts.

Title: Maintain separate program balances
Requirement: Configure entertainment and prize-eligible coin types, precision, grant sources and permitted uses. Display both balances and rule versions.
Acceptance test: Grant 100 entertainment and 5 prize-eligible coins. The two balances remain 100 and 5. Attempting prize redemption with entertainment coins returns an ineligible result.
Résultat et écart: Le solde Demo Credits est isolé. Soldes de divertissement et de prix, règles et unités du programme restent à choisir.

Title: Issue promotional and alternative entries
Requirement: Record package grants per currency, daily rewards and no-purchase intake, including mail-in if configured. Track eligibility, duplicate requests and reasoned decisions.
Acceptance test: Process one eligible no-purchase entry twice under a fixture rule granting 2 prize units. There is one grant of 2 and a traceable decision. The daily limit applies at the configured day boundary.
Résultat et écart: La règle d’entrée alternative et ses limites doivent être choisies pour le programme.

Title: Review and fulfill prize redemptions
Requirement: Check age/identity, program rules, threshold and available eligible units. Reserve at request, release on denial and mark fulfillment with a reference.
Acceptance test: From 12 eligible units with a threshold of 10, request 10 twice concurrently. One reservation succeeds. A denial restores 12. A later fulfilled request carries one receipt.
Résultat et écart: Règles d’admissibilité, réservation et traitement d’un prix restent à choisir pour cette verticale.

Title: Manage integration clients and adapters
Requirement: Store partner/environment scope, capability flags, approved endpoints, credential references, provider test status and a rotation history.
Acceptance test: A test client can read its brand’s fixture. A second brand and a production resource are denied. Rotate its credential and verify the superseded credential loses access.
Résultat et écart: Client de lecture limité à une marque et au bac à sable. Rotation, révocation et historique vérifiés. Registre de plusieurs adaptateurs, endpoints et capacités reste ouvert.

Title: Serve a published lobby to a custom site
Requirement: Return versioned categories, ordering, assets, language fallbacks and eligible titles to a bespoke front end. Cache by all audience and market inputs.
Acceptance test: Request two published lobbies for different markets. Each receives its own categories. Withdrawing a title invalidates both applicable caches and its direct listing.
Résultat et écart: API versionnée publique et partenaire, même sélection, retrait immédiat des fiches, marché, appareil et repli des libellés. Arbre de catégories et illustrations localisées restent ouverts.

Title: Deliver reliable partner events
Requirement: Offer consented CRM, affiliate and account/wallet event subscriptions as selected. Sign and version outbound messages, apply bounded retries and expose a dead-letter replay action.
Acceptance test: A subscriber returns a temporary error then succeeds. Its stable event ID permits one business effect. Permanent failures reach the operations queue and replays retain the same event ID.
Résultat et écart: Le client actuel lit le hall. Abonnements sortants, reprises bornées et file des livraisons échouées restent ouverts.

Title: Post isolated grants and debits
Requirement: Accept positive whole units, reason and a request key. Serialize debits against the available test balance and reject undesignated or public accounts.
Acceptance test: Grant 100 and debit 20. Balance is 80. A public account and an operator in the wrong environment cannot post. A fractional grant is rejected.
Résultat et écart: Octroi, débit entier et rejet des comptes/environnements non admissibles vérifiés.

Title: Reverse, replay and verify test receipts
Requirement: Allow one full compensating reversal subject to the balance floor. Preserve the original receipt on a repeated request and show all movements to permitted staff.
Acceptance test: Reverse the 20-unit debit and replay its original request. Balance is 100 across three movements. Two competing 80-unit debits from that balance cannot both succeed.
Résultat et écart: Contrepassation, reçu rejouable et débits concurrents vérifiés sur le registre de crédits séparé.
